usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and Zulip tells the team when “Send Stream Message” follows “New Task Created in Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Send Stream Message” in Zulip
bestTemplate.why: A new task posts to a Zulip stream and topic, so the right people see it.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so the Zulip message arrives after a scheduled check.
